Subject: Venue power, PDUs and telemetry — initial ask for Oct 12 workshop

Hi team,

We're finalizing the technical plan for the Oct 12 executive workshop at the Harbor Tower Conference Center (Vanguard Systems). Before we lock racks and bridge capacity I'd like to confirm the following site-level details so we can map our transcoder/routing and staging racks: 

- Available rack elevations (U) in Auditorium A and Stage Room B; any restrictions on 42U vs 24U racks
- Number and types of PDUs on-site (single-phase/three-phase), available outlet types, and capacity per circuit (amps)
- Presence of redundant power feeds and UPS/battery runtime (if any) for the AV staging room
- Network demarcation point for our bridge: switch model, available 10/25/40G uplinks, whether SNMP polling is allowed
- On-site monitoring endpoints for environmental telemetry (temperature/humidity sensors, PDU SNMP OIDs) and whether remote SNMP v2/v3 credentials can be provisioned during test window

Attachments: None from our side yet — please send the latest venue floor plan and your PDUs inventory CSV. Target: we need this validated by EOD 2026-08-07 so we can finalize rack orders and crossover cabling.

Who should I loop for carrier circuit provisioning if we need a temporary DIA or backup bond? Also call out any lead time for on-site AV techs to configure SNMP credentials (if supported).

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Venue power, PDUs and telemetry — initial ask for Oct 12 workshop

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the checklist — attached are the floor plan (venue_floor_plan_v3.pdf) and our current pdu_inventory.csv. Quick answers inline: 

- Rack elevations: Auditorium A has two 42U racks in the stage alcove; Stage Room B has one reserved 24U rack (no more than 18U available for third-party gear without prior sign-off).
- PDUs: Mix of single-phase (most common) and two PDU cabinets with three-phase. Main stage feed is a 200A three-phase (we can supply panel map).
- Redundant feeds: Auditorium A has a redundant feed and an on-site UPS with ~12 minutes runtime at half load; Stage B does not have redundant mains unless we bring a portable UPS (we can quote rentals).
- Network: Demarc is in the loading dock MDF room. We can provide a leaf switch (Cisco 9300 series) with two 10G uplinks. Secondary uplink requires request 5 days in advance. SNMP is supported; we prefer SNMPv3 for security.

We can provision temporary firewall rules for your bridge IPs during test windows; please provide the IP ranges. On-site AV techs (GreenField AV) can be scheduled for the pre-test on Oct 10 or Oct 11.

Attachments: venue_floor_plan_v3.pdf, pdu_inventory.csv

Let me know if you want a quick call to walk the rack elevations and power panels — I can do 30 minutes tomorrow afternoon.

Best,

Marcus Ortiz 
Ops Manager, Allied Events

- Primary bridge uplink: reserve one 10G port (Cisco 9300) with public-facing NAT/ACL for Redwood bridge IPs (Jonas to provide ranges) — Owner: Jonas (action: send IP ranges by 2026-08-07)
- Power: reserve two 20A circuits on separate PDUs for critical encoder/tran scoder racks; request confirmation of three-phase panel map for Auditorium A — Owner: Allied Events (action: provide panel map)
- SNMP telemetry: request SNMPv3 read-only account for PDU OIDs and environmental sensors during event window; credentials to be shared securely via our secrets process (v2 is unacceptable) — Owner: GreenField AV (action: confirm SNMPv3 support and lead time)
- On-site test: schedule a dry-run on Oct 10 with carrier test and bridge call; Evelyn Hart to lead operations and run the failover exercise — Owner: Evelyn Hart
